A newspaper written by anyone, for everyone — 8 sections (Local, World, Campus, Tech, Sports, Arts, Opinion, Investigations), tight word-count editing rules, pull quotes, images and captions. Live on Cloudflare Workers.

8 nesting test files for laser cutting — 'nested all' plus 7 CheckedNestedGroup variants, exercise CAD nesting on the laser bed.
